notes.title: Update Hotfix 2.1.2
notes.content:
You may have wondered what the update was about that we just dropped. It was a quality-of-life hotfix containing these items in update 2.1.2:

[list]
[*] Allow to reset progress from the game settings menu; beware this will affect purchases as well, and should only be used if you tried the game in the past, and are just confused where to pickup. This was a feature requested almost daily, so jump into Discord and take part in discussions!
[*] Defensive squad power is now displayed for opponents in the PvP arena
[*] Matchmaking algorithm improved to mitigate matchmaking starvation at the top and the bottom of the leaderboard. This should lead to faster battles to be found.
[*] Added Restart button to quickly replay PvE battles. Another feature requested by the Discord community!
[*] PvP Arena rewards can be examined from the Leaderboard window now (KNOWN ISSUE: Rewards may not yet be issued, and will be fixed with the next update).
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes 2.1.0
notes.content:
[h1]PvP Arena[/h1]
Fight in the arena with your legendary samurai heroes for a chance to earn valuable loot. Engage in intense battles with other players and aim to become #1 in the rankings!

[h3]The Rules:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Winning a battle will earn you TROPHIES. Losing a battle will lead to the loss of some of these TROPHIES.
[*] The number of TROPHIES you hold determines your RANK—your place on the leaderboard.
[*] You use your ATTACKERS squad to fight against other players. Choose your opponent, configure your squad, and fight!
[*] You use your DEFENDERS squad to defend against other players' invasions. Configure it beforehand via the specified menu to always be ready.
[*] Each Arena lasts for two weeks. At the end, you will earn valuable rewards.
[*] The higher your RANK, the better the rewards you receive upon Arena completion.
[/olist]
Exchange your rewards at the Arena trader for schemes of Iron Pick and Iron Axe, shards of Sanada Yukimura, and other useful resources.

[h1]Picks & Axes Upgrades[/h1]
Meet the new craftsman at your estate when you reach prosperity level 3: he will transform your rusty tools into brand-new iron ones. Use the tool schemes to enhance your existing tools, upgrading their durability and gaining additional features. Combine schemes to acquire those of superior rarity. Schemes can be purchased from the Arena trader.

[h1]New Seasons[/h1]
Prepare for the upcoming seasons, which will provide you with the opportunity to collect heroes such as Honda Tadakatsu and Ittosai Kagehisa, now included in the free rewards track as well!

[h1]Changes in Mini-Events[/h1]
Guaranteed mini-events upon entering the Pine Forest: now you will encounter 2-3 mini-events upon entry if they are available, according to their personal cooldowns. The appearance of king animals has also become an event: you will discover an altar dedicated to a random animal and can summon it using resources.

notes.title: Samurai Legends Showcase: Momotaro!
notes.content:
[h2]Samurai Legend Showcase![/h2]

Let's get to know a bit better the second of our samurai heroes - Momotaro. While her exact origin remains unknown, legend has it that she was found as a child inside a giant peach floating in the river.
Harnessing the powers of nature, Momotaro is designed to assist other heroes in healing their wounds and strengthening them with her spell, which clearly positions her as the supporter in your legendary squad.
You can obtain Momotaro's shards by completing Campaign Missions.

notes.title: Samurai Legends Mode Guide!
notes.content:
[h3]Samurai legends game mode is here![/h3] 

It can be a little tricky to get into at first, but have no fear, we are here with tips and tricks on how to improve your hero roster power!

Here are all the possible ways to strengthen your heroes in this mode:

🌟 Hero Levels 🌟
Each new Hero Level enhances Hero stats. Level up by gaining experience from Campaign Missions and spending gold in the Hero Menu at the Heroes Camp. Hero Levels also boost the maximum level of Hero Abilities.

⭐️ Hero Stars (Evolving a Hero) ⭐️
Hero Stars improve Hero stats. For instance, at level 10, a Hero with 1 star has 50 Strength, while a 2-star Hero has 65 Strength. Higher hero levels yield more significant improvements. Collect Hero Shards from various sources to earn new Stars.

🏆 Hero Rank 🏆
Equipping a full set of items increases the Hero's Rank, unlocking new Abilities. Each equipped item enhances the Hero's stats.

✨ Hero Abilities ✨
Unlocked as the Hero's Rank increases, Abilities require a specific Hero Level and Gold for upgrades. Explore detailed characteristics and descriptions in the Hero menu at the Heroes' Camp.

Here is a short video with explanation:

[previewyoutube=_LtyZ3uWOxE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.content:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368306/073cf9be3f8f89e86b71200a1b595d27812d255a.jpg[/img]

[list]

[*]Dive into automatic PvE battles where your strategic skills determine the victor.
[*]Unlock heroes through various in-game events and mechanics.
[*]Increase your Prosperity level to unlock the Heroes Camp within your castle's territory. For more details on the mechanics, refer to the information board at the camp.
[/list]

[h1]New Festive Season: Dragon's Journey[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368306/7048bccc56e6f810ada0222d24b393d18b5fa2aa.png[/img]

Celebrate the Lunar New Year with our new season! Complete quests, earn a magnificent dragon statue and other festive decorations for your estate, and welcome the legendary hero Ittosai Kagehisa to your camp, who wields the power to strike enemies with lightning bolts.
The season begins on February 9th at 15:10 UTC and will span 28 days.

[h1]Pearls Re-design[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368306/57296106817e0169672b5e2a636cb91fe9652ee1.png[/img]

Pearls have expanded utility: they're no longer just for buying and selling tools but also for acquiring shards of the special hero Ishikawa Goemon. Look for a trader at the previous location of one of the tools traders.
We've overhauled the primary method of obtaining Pearls: they are no longer purchasable with dojo coins. Now, you can earn them as rewards for completing daily quests. Two new daily quests have been added: one involves visiting the Iron Mine, and the other involves winning campaign missions.
Animal bosses in the Pine Forest will continue to drop pearls. However, these animals are now summoned via special altars and have a cooldown period before they can reappear.

[h1]Keys and Seals Traders[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368306/9590d89dae4472f43c654521d896f53e582a066e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368306/d18619512f3cc0ed1edc78abe58da2f1aaed7a60.png[/img]

Your estate welcomes two additional traders.
A key trader has taken over the former spot, and now you can purchase both free and premium keys in one location.
All options for obtaining Samurai Seals have been centralized: you'll still receive one free seal daily and another for watching a video ad, plus you can buy a pack with coins, a pack with dojo coins, or choose to purchase seals with gems.

[h1]Changes in Dojo Rating[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368306/945638a87c67fa66560e255c1834118d804afc26.png[/img]

Places 4-10 are now awarded with Dojo Statues.
In addition to acquiring the red kimono set, you can now obtain shards of the unique hero Nezumi Kozo using Dojo Coins and Dojo Statues.

notes.title: Update Notes 1.8.2
notes.content:
[h3]🎄 Daisho version 1.8.2 is now available![/h3]

We've restructured the Estate map for improved logistics. The Castle and Dojo are now conveniently located next to the Estate's main square. Tool Merchants have been relocated to share a square with the coins merchant. The area to the right is now dedicated solely to reconstructible houses and the events market square. Additionally, the bridge to the Iron Mine has been moved closer, right next to the Pine Forest entrance.

[h3]Other Changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Treasure chests containing equipment have been combined into a single chest with options to open either 1 or 10 at a time. This update also applies to jewelry treasure chests.
[*] We've rebalanced the early-game building upgrade costs. Tool Merchants are now accessible at Prosperity level 4 and come with a new introduction quest (existing players will encounter this dialogue too, which can be skipped).
[*] Corrected the initial Attack Power talent values for weapons with tags: they were incorrectly set to 1 instead of 0.
[*] Fixed the spawning position of the mini-event cave in the Night Pine Forest to prevent players from getting stuck.
[/list]

💥 Check out this updated plan if you're having trouble locating something on your Estate. 👨‍🚀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368306/39a5b8673b935e8b2e21bdc72a54822ca2b34129.png[/img]

notes.title: The Winter Festival Has Begun!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368306/4af184c94c9ffda27ab0334cc9391ed125118b28.png[/img]

[h3]🎉✨ The Winter Festival Has Begun! ✨🎉[/h3]

Nobunaga, seeking to uplift the spirits of his people, invited Nagoya's finest merchants for a grand fair. However, on their journey, these merchants fell victim to a bandit attack and lost many of their goods. It's time to restore joy and beauty to the market square!

🦶 Tanuki Shrine Upgrade: Be a part of beautifying the market square by upgrading the Tanuki Shrine at its heart.
💌 Collect Greeting Cards: Embark on mini-adventures in the Pine Forest to collect Greeting Cards. These are your key to leveling up the Tanuki Shrine and unlocking amazing rewards.
🎁 Gifts of Tanuki: Open Tanuki's gifts once a day for free and use Lucky Coins for more. Each level up of the shrine not only enhances its beauty but also improves the rewards you can receive.
🏹 Exciting Rewards Await: Keep an eye out for the main prizes - a unique crossbow that pushes enemies back and a coronet that boosts critical chances for two-handed ranged weapons. Reach the ultimate level 30 of the Tanuki Shrine and be guaranteed to receive a special Tanuki decoration for your estate.
🔄 Traders Galore: Visit the market regularly and explore the Pine Forest to find traders. Exchange different goods for the Greeting Cards and sometimes even Lucky Coins.

[i]The festivities span 12 days of fun and excitement.[/i] Don’t miss out on making the most of this Winter Festival! Embrace the spirit, upgrade the shrine, and enjoy the rewards!

notes.title: Release Patch Notes 1.8.0
notes.content:
🎄 Daisho version 1.8.0 is now available!

[h3]Winter Festival[/h3]

Prepare for a festive celebration in Kiyosu! Nobunaga is rallying his people's spirit and has invited Nagoya's finest merchants for a grand fair. Here's what you can do:

[list]
[*]  Assist the merchants in recovering their stolen goods and earn special greeting cards as a reward.
[*]  Restore the Tanuki Shrine: each level unlocks increasingly attractive rewards.
[*]  Obtain exclusive rewards including a unique decoration, a powerful crossbow, and a headpiece to enhance your archery skills.
[/list]

[i]*The festival window opens from 12:00 PM UTC on December 14th and runs until January 10th. The festivities will span 12 days from the start date.*[/i]

🎁[h3] Christmas Season[/h3]

The new Battle Pass season kicks off at 3:10 PM UTC on December 15th and lasts for 28 days. Discover winter-themed exclusive rewards, including decorations for your estate and a blueprint for crafting the Frosty Pickaxe. This upgraded tool is more durable than its predecessor and can generate additional parameters.

[h3]🌐 Travel Without Borders[/h3]

Utilize fast travel via special flags or the new button in the interface to move effortlessly around your estate or to other locations at no cost. You can fast-travel from the gardens to the castle or from the dojo to the pine forest. Note that only certain locations (Estate and Sanzu hub) have the interface button for fast travel; other areas feature specific flag-marked spots for transportation to various destinations.

[h3]⚔️ Raids[/h3]

Meet a new NPC near the boat station: hire this mercenary with Samurai Seals to venture into the Pine Forest and swiftly return with resources. Samurai Seals, previously known as Transit Passes (since they're no longer used for traveling), serve as payment for his services.

[h3]🛠 Fixes and Minor Updates[/h3]

[list]
[*]  Resolved an issue where players couldn't find a hatch on the 3rd floor of the Iron Mine.
[*]  Addressed a rare bug where an item wasn't consumed during equipment merging.
[*]  Attack Power and Bonus Damage now display decimal values in equipment tooltips. This change also applies to the Attack Power in the informational panel.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Patch Notes 1.7.0
notes.content:
[h1]Update 1.7 is now available![/h1]

[h2]🌾 Harvest Festival[/h2]

A festival market will soon be set up next to Kiyosu Castle! This presents an opportunity to collect missing equipment parts from past events and seasons, as well as to acquire a unique festival item. The festival is scheduled to begin on November 23rd and will last for 7 days. Stay updated by following our social networks for notifications on the market's opening!

[h2]⛏️ Iron Mine Revisited[/h2]

Advance through levels, encounter new enemies, and find better loot the deeper you venture. Currently, 5 levels are available, with more to be added in future updates.

As usual, you will need a torch to enter the mine. Once inside, you can progress through the floors until you either die or exit the mine via the ladder.
Each floor is a distinct world, randomly generated with resources to mine, enemies to defeat, and tougher opponents offering even greater rewards.
The hatch to descend to the next level isn't just lying around - it's hidden! You'll need to mine objects strategically to discover the passageway to the next floor.
Choose wisely; once you leave a floor, there is no returning to it on the same journey.
If you choose to leave the mine, it will rejuvenate, resetting your adventure from the first floor and requiring a new torch fee for re-entry.

[h2]📦 Storages[/h2]

Players can utilize resources from any storage in peaceful locations like the Estate and Sanzu hub. Priority order for resource retrieval is as follows:

[olist]
[*] Player's inventory
[*] Mailbox
[*] General storage
[*] Chest storage
[/olist]

[h2]Other Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Dojo now resets at the same time for everyone: at 13:00 UTC.
[*] Added wakizashi icon to the durability widget to show when it is broken.
[*] Added ability description for the Spirit Striker bow.
[*] Replaced the models of wolves and deer.
[*] Replaced visuals for the purple flowers on the farms.
[*] Advertising rewards are now available on Google PC and Android Emulators.
[*] [PC] Combat animations cannot be interrupted by movement.
[/list]

❗️ Important notice!

There is a small bug in this version which we will address in the patch 1.7.1.
When you die in the Dojo your character will stay there as a corpse. This is unintended and will be fixed as soon as possible.
A temporary solution would be reloading the game - you will return back to your base alive.

notes.title: Upcoming version Sneak Peak: Iron Mine changes!
notes.content:

🛠️ We're revamping the way the Iron Mine works:

Say hello to a new structure: levels upon levels of mining madness in our upcoming update!

[list]
[*] As usual you spend a torch to enter the mine, and then you progress through the floors till you die or exit the mine through the ladder.
[*] Each floor is a small world of its own, randomly generated with resources to mine, enemies to defeat, and new formidable opponents with even sweeter rewards.
[*] The hatch to ascend to the next level isn't just lying around - it's hidden! You'll need to mine objects strategically to discover the passageway to the next floor.
[*] Make your choices wisely; once you ascend from a floor, there’s no going back on the same journey.
[*] If you decide to leave the mine’s embrace, it rejuvenates, resetting your adventure from the very first floor with a new torch fee.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=VvsCsbygJ5g;full][/previewyoutube]

With 5 floors to explore and more on the horizon, your mining skills will be put to the test. Will you emerge victorious with your pockets full, or will the depths of the mine claim your torch?

notes.content:
[h1]Daisho Version 1.6.0 is now available![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368306/abadf0c89a2476c53bad812bc24f15a01ba74260.png[/img]

[h2]Even More Halloween! 🎃[/h2]

Prepare yourself for additional surprises that will emerge in the event zone this Friday evening! Follow our social media channels and don’t miss the start of the final phase of the Ghost Parade. You will also meet a new event character who can exchange your Halloween weapons of tier I to the valuable resources or tier II weapons.

[h2]Auto-Mode Updates 🤖[/h2]

All locations gain the Auto-Mode feature back.
Resettable locations (Pine Forest, Iron Mine, event bog) will not be changed in their settings and will keep a big radius for searching, gathering, and attacking foes. Other locations (the Estate, for example) will be set up with a small radius, just like it was before, so you'll be able to auto-collect crops from the farm. In the Dojo, an increased target selection radius will be applied, allowing Auto-Mode to target ranged enemies as well.
In addition, you will be able to browse your inventory and other game interfaces during Auto-Mode again.

[h2]Information Panel ℹ️[/h2]

We’ve gathered all the information about your enchantments in one convenient space. All bonuses, such as Critical Chance, Critical Damage, Block Chances,
Health, Armor, Damage, etc., will be listed there to help you unlock the maximum potential from your equipment.

[h2]New Short Seasons ⏰[/h2]

Right after the Spooky Season, a new season will commence, bringing with it significant changes:

[list]
[*] Its duration will be two weeks, as opposed to the customary four.
[*] Levels, rewards, and quests have been recalibrated to be more attainable on a daily basis.
[*] A new reward set has been introduced, featuring simple decorations and special rechargeable decorations that generate rewards.
[/list]

[h2]Other Fixes and Improvements 🛠️[/h2]

[list]
[*] Expensive treasure chests with equipment, jewelry, and the event shrine now send rewards to the postbox.
[*] Upgraded tiger models in the Dojo.
[*] Enhanced optimization of character shadows.
[*] Substituted "White Flower" and its corresponding baskets with "Purple Flower" to eliminate confusion with the visually identical Night Flower.
[*] Replaced audio effects for the Beasts.
[*] Fixed the Potion of Fletcher to boost flint drop in the Iron Mine
[*] Relocated the spawning point of the mystic cave and one of the houses in the Pine Forest to prevent passage blockages.
[*] Addressed an issue that could potentially result in server disconnections at the Dojo.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Patch-Notes 1.4.0
notes.content:
[h1]Battle Pass[/h1]

Embark on a journey like no other as you immerse yourself in a season filled with daily and weekly quests that will test your skills and unlock an array of exclusive treasures.

The first season starts on [b]Friday, September 8th, at 13:00 UTC[/b] and will last for 28 days.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368306/9710dc07333e6220e444b8bd1b9edc02a3b66fb0.png[/img]

[h1]Dojo Leaderboards[/h1]

Compete on the Dojo Leaderboards and let your combat skills speak for themselves. For each wave you win, you earn points, and it matters how fast you complete the wave. Each wave reset gives you a chance to improve your score.
Showcase your finesse on the leaderboards to claim weekly prizes, including essential resources that will aid you in your noble journey. But there's more – special tokens, symbols of your expertise, will grant you access to a unique kimono design.

Available at Prosperity level 7. The first competition starts on [b]Monday, September 11th, at 13:00 UTC[/b] and will last for 7 days. It will restart every Monday with a 1-hour interval.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368306/df027f2aec917f8ad47e6fa9a9928f9028d421b2.jpg[/img]

[h1]Daily Mini-Events[/h1]

Every time you visit the Pine Forest, whether day or night, keep your eyes open for mini-events that may occur there, giving you a chance to collect additional loot.
Events are available at Prosperity 3 and higher. You need to complete them without leaving the forest, or the quest will fail. The cooldown between events is at least 4 hours. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368306/4bfe3a2c5c40d310b506ffcc344ec8607e9b6fa4.png[/img]

[h1]Jewelry[/h1]

New equipment slots have appeared in your inventory: collect rings and amulets to empower your hero. Jewelry can be obtained from enemies in the Iron Mine (available at Prosperity level 6). They can then be merged at the jeweler's stand next to the Forge. There are 4 types of amulets and 6 types of rings, most of which have a unique stat associated with them. There is also a new storage to store your jewelry.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368306/ffaa57e21bbb18b014daa1dd55123eaa63c9966c.jpg[/img]

[h1]New territory: Gardens[/h1]

A new beautiful expansion for your Estate territory is available at Prosperity level 9: the Gardens. Restore it to complete the quest and upgrade your estate's prosperity even further.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368306/df027f2aec917f8ad47e6fa9a9928f9028d421b2.jpg[/img]

[h1]Improved auto-mode[/h1]

Auto mode can now prioritize attacking nearby enemies. It can also loot enemies, and the range of this mode has been extended.
We enhanced drop looting even more: if your inventory is full but there is still space in the resource storage for an item, the item will be automatically collected into the resource storage.
So kick back and relax, just use your health potions from time to time to keep your hero grinding.

[h1]Other features and fixes include:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Inventory can now be upgraded with coins. You can read about this decision here: ⁠general-chat⁠
[*] A new storage for consumables is available at Prosperity level 4.
[*] Economy Rebalance to match the game without the energy system. You will see changes in: coins merchant, XP merchant, resource shop, equipment upgrades.
[*] The Prosperity level up window shows which mechanics are unlocked at the current level and what to expect next.
[*] Animal bosses now appear at the night pine forest location.
[*] [Steam] Free rewards from No Ads are available to collect on PC if you purchased it on mobile. Remember that you can link your game progresses with the help of our Support.
[*] The progress bar between locations will now show the loading progress.
[*] Fix: some previously forgotten resources have been added to the resource storage (such as iron nails and needle, crude cloth, etc.).
[*] Divided Shinobi and Bandit Amulets drops in the night location, so now they may drop both without blocking each other.
[*] Boars now attack the player only if their fellow boars are attacked within their range.
[*] XP trader is now unlocked at Prosperity 4.
[*] Death animation for humans has been replaced for better loot collection with PC controls.
[/list]

 Join our Discord to share and discuss your thoughts on the update!

notes.content:
[h1]Hey there brave samurai![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368306/fe5889741123338b35e2eff9e6ed42650d398c45.png[/img]

[h2]A word from the developer team.[/h2]

As this is our first time working on a Steam and crossplatform project, we are looking forward to your feedback! If you like the experience, please consider leaving a comment or a review, which really helps a lot. If you don’t, that's totally fine, feel free to let us know. We read every review and every message in Steam discussions.

[h2]A teaser of what’s coming in the next update for Daisho![/h2]

We want to bring more variety to exploration of Pine Forest 🌲 so we decided to add side activities! Check this area and see if anyone needs your help. Search for hidden treasures with your new allies, hold mystic rituals, free captives and more! 👘

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368306/4bfe3a2c5c40d310b506ffcc344ec8607e9b6fa4.png[/img]
There is more interesting stuff currently in development as well, so come join our Discord  where you can interact with developer team and get new info on the upcoming feature and release dates!

[url=https://discord.gg/TutCRbZryR][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368306/30ce41573324e7e9c90bd02d50e8f20381caba88.png[/img][/url]
